functions.name: FUN_100098f0
new_strings: Are you crazy? Whatever you do, don't try to leave with them. The guard outside may search you!
Thanks, but I don't want them. A word of warning though, my friend. The guard outside often searches us, so you should find a way to hide them or smuggle them out.
Well done! Your bravery and cleverness have helped bring us all one step closer to freedom!
Well done, but you'll have to hide them in here somewhere, or the guard will find them when you leave the kitchen.
